Download and import a UCDP dataset

Source: R/get.R
ucdp_get.Rd

Download and import a UCDP dataset

Usage

ucdp_get(
  dataset,
  format = "csv",
  variant = NULL,
  version = NULL,
  dest_dir = tempdir(),
  overwrite = TRUE,
  include_historical = !is.null(version),
  quiet = FALSE,
  catalog = NULL,
  ...,
  keep_file = FALSE
)

Arguments

dataset

Dataset name, alias, or regular expression. Use ucdp_search() to inspect matches. Common aliases include ged, candidate, prio, dyadic, nonstate, onesided, brd, and actor.

format

Preferred format, including "csv", "xlsx", "dta", "rdata", "sql", "shapefile", "geojson", or "any".

variant

Optional regular expression used to select among variants such as dyadic/conflict-level BRD files or onset datasets.

version

Optional exact UCDP version, for example "24.1" or "25.0.12". Supplying a version automatically searches the historical catalog. Use ucdp_versions() to inspect downloadable releases.

dest_dir

Destination directory. It is created when necessary.

overwrite

Replace an existing file?

include_historical

Search the historical-download page too?

quiet

Suppress messages and download progress?

catalog

Optional pre-fetched catalog, useful for repeated downloads.

...

Additional arguments passed to the relevant reader (readr, readxl, or haven).

keep_file

Keep the downloaded file? The default stores it in a temporary directory and removes it after import.

Value

An imported data object. CSV files return a tibble; Excel and Stata files return the objects produced by readxl and haven.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ged <- ucdp_get("ged", format = "csv")
} # }
